question: what single constant places gen1 at Elba on the surveyed datum, how well is it known, and what does that fix in the DoD?

inputs.role: gen1 checkpoint ties, chained into the elbaext swath frame and geoid-shifted
gen2 checkpoint ties, direct: no chain, no geoid, no lateral term
elba_fulldensity pipeline corrections: datum method, per-swath alignment, grid definition
elbaext pipeline corrections: the SAME swaths aligned from a different extent -- the repeatability measurement
gen2 gridded ground, 5 m -- the surface dod is measured from
gen2 minus gen1 on the 5 m grid; gen1 = z_after - dod

params.name: band_km
params.why: the on-band stratum elba_absolute_tie.py declares before any tie is computed; off-band marks carry unmodelled along-track drift at the measured 15.5 mm/km

params.name: anchor_types
params.why: 3DEP's own accuracy classes: NVA is open ground at 3.5 cm RMSEz, VVA is under vegetation at 27 cm @95%. Both are reported; only NVA anchors.

params.name: block_m
params.why: block size for the spatially varying residual. Chosen to be far larger than the 5 m grid and far smaller than the 2.5 x 3.5 km tile so there are tens of blocks; the result is reported with its block count and its sampling-noise correction so the choice is visible.

params.name: datum_method
params.why: elba_fulldensity/corrections.json -- the geoid-only datum the product was built on; the tie constant is applied ON TOP of it, not instead

columns.kind: random = independent between marks (averages down); common = shared by every tie (does NOT average down); unmodelled = a bound with no measured distribution (reported, never added in)
columns.applies_to: which ties the term acts on
columns.source: the array, mask or formula the value was computed from
columns.type: NVA = open ground, VVA = under vegetation
columns.tie_mm: constant to ADD to gen1 from this mark, mm
columns.sig_mm: half its spread across the pipeline-scale radii, mm
columns.links: cross-swath links from the covering line to the elbaext frame
columns.dN_km: distance from the corridor band the links were solved in, km
columns.role: anchor, or the reason this mark does not anchor
columns.swath: gen1 flight line whose two independent alignments are compared
columns.nlink: links from the comparison reference swath
columns.disagree_mm: elbaext minus elba_fulldensity alignment for that swath, mm
columns.per_link_mm: that disagreement divided by sqrt(nlink), mm
columns.quantity: what is being reported about the spatially varying residual
columns.value: its value, with its own units stated in the cell (mm, or a count)

headline: gen1 datum constant at Elba = +22.7 mm +/- 39.7 mm (random 34.0, common 20.5), unmodelled bound 43 mm; spatial residual sd 31.7 mm is untouched by it
